invariants.rationale: After Math.max(0, x) is assigned back to x, x cannot be negative at method exit.
The code computes height - y and uses it for cursorLine; thus, typically y is at most getHeight().
The x value is meant to represent a position within the UI element; it should not exceed the element width.
y typically represents a coordinate within the UI area, which generally cannot be negative after processing.
Since both x and y are constrained to be non-negative, their sum will also be non-negative.
